## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and scope.

## Validation

- [ ] TypeScript, lint, tests, coverage, and build pass.
- [ ] New behavior has automated tests.
- [ ] Compatibility and rollback impact are documented.
- [ ] Performance impact is measured or marked not applicable.
- [ ] No credential, token, customer URL, email, or PII is present.
- [ ] Package contents and generated evidence were reviewed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes have owner review.

## Seven quality principles

Mark each as improved, verified unchanged, not applicable, or deferred:

- Compatibility:
- Maintainability:
- Adaptability/integrations:
- Security:
- Novice-professional usability:
- Performance:
- Workload balancing/scalability:
